rows.summary: MIDFLORIDA Credit Union (Lakeland, FL) acquired Prime Meridian Bank (Tallahassee, FL) after regulatory approval, its third bank acquisition in five years; closing March 1, 2026; Prime Meridian customers can use MIDFLORIDA branches and the account conversion is on April 17, 2026 (MIDFLORIDA branch access from April 20).

rows.institution: First Citizens Bank of Butte (acquired by Frontier Credit Union, ID)
rows.summary: Frontier Credit Union (Idaho Falls, ID) closed its acquisition of First Citizens Bank of Butte on Sunday (Feb 1, 2026), Frontier's first Montana location and the first credit union to fully acquire a bank in Montana; account conversions and full systems integration expected by August.

rows.institution: The Miners State Bank (to be acquired by Zeal Credit Union, MI)
rows.summary: Zeal Credit Union and The Miners State Bank entered a definitive agreement (announced Jan. 8, 2026) for Zeal to purchase substantially all assets and liabilities in an all-cash deal; Zeal's current member page anticipates closing on Jan. 1, 2027, with branch signage changes on or shortly before that date (the original announcement expected a close by the end of Q4 2026). Zeal would exceed $1.1B in assets with 22 branches and expand in Michigan's Upper Peninsula.

rows.institution: Lewis & Clark Bank (acquired by Maps Credit Union, OR)
rows.summary: Maps Credit Union (Marion and Polk Schools CU, Salem, OR) completed its acquisition of Lewis & Clark Bank (purchase and assumption of substantially all assets and liabilities, all cash) on December 31, 2025 (announced Jan 7, 2026); Maps now has over $1.7B in assets, 83,000+ members and 14 branches, extending into the Portland region and North Coast, with full integration expected in Q1 2027.

rows.institution: The Peoples Bank (acquired by Hanscom Federal Credit Union, MA)
rows.summary: Hanscom Federal Credit Union completed its purchase and assumption of the majority of assets and liabilities of The Peoples Bank (Maryland), Hanscom's entry into Maryland and Washington, D.C.; the bank now operates as Peoples Powered by Hanscom FCU with systems conversion expected summer 2026.

rows.institution: Winter Park National Bank (acquired by DFCU Financial, MI)
rows.summary: DFCU Financial (Dearborn, MI) completed its previously announced business combination with Winter Park National Bank (Central Florida); all bank locations now operate under the DFCU name and the bank's former CEO is now Central Florida Area President for DFCU.

rows.institution: 1st Bank Yuma (acquired by OneAZ Credit Union, AZ)
rows.summary: OneAZ Credit Union completed its acquisition of 1st Bank Yuma effective Nov. 21, 2025; combined assets grew to more than $4.0B, expanding OneAZ into Yuma, San Luis and Nogales, AZ.

Financial Center First named Brent Gifford its new Chief Information Officer; he was most recently CIO at P1FCU (Idaho), has 30 years of technology leadership, and the CU says technology will play a larger role in how it serves members.

Metro Credit Union (largest state-chartered CU in Massachusetts) promoted Traci Michel to Executive Vice President to oversee alignment of strategy, operations and execution; she was SVP, COO and Chief Strategy Officer and led a multi-year effort to modernize Metro's core and ancillary banking systems.

Cobalt Credit Union appointed Benjamin Rempe chief financial officer, responsible for financial strategy, governance and administrative operations including accounting, finance, payments and facilities, plus ALM and forecasting.

Blue Eagle Credit Union (Roanoke) added Ashley Fiore as Chief Financial Officer; she has nearly 20 years of finance, banking and technology experience and plans to bring finance, data, technology and strategy skills to the role.

CommunityAmerica Credit Union (Lenexa, KS) announced Rhonda Pavlicek has joined as Chief Financial Officer, leading financial strategy; she has 30+ years of financial leadership experience, much of it in credit unions.

Centris FCU (Omaha) hired Dave Ridder as Executive Vice President, Chief Credit Officer; he joins from American National Bank where he was Chief Banking Officer and earlier Chief Credit Officer, and will oversee credit philosophy and lending strategy.
PenAir Credit Union (Pensacola) promoted Ryan Vann from vice president of consumer lending to Chief Lending Officer.

SchoolsFirst FCU (Tustin, CA) promoted Carol Rose from EVP of Member Service Operations to chief operating officer and Jim Phillips from EVP to chief information officer (he continues to lead technology strategy, infrastructure and cybersecurity) and added new leadership positions.
JM Associates FCU (Jacksonville) announced President/CEO Jim Ryan will retire after 35 years; the board named EVP Robert Griffin as successor, effective September 1, 2026.
Seaboard FCU (Bucksport, ME; assets grew from $42M to $248M) said President/CEO Kyle Casburn will retire May 31, 2027 after 31 years; CU Today's report does not name a successor.

Maui County FCU appointed Henry Arroyo Chief Information Officer, overseeing IT strategy, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance and technology infrastructure; he was most recently Manager of Core Cloud Services at Tessitura Network.
McDowell Cornerstone Credit Union (Marion, NC; a $38M CU chartered in 1967) named Sarah Washburn as its new CEO.
Chemcel FCU (Corpus Christi) named Justin Eddleton president and CEO to succeed Michael Engel, who has led the CU since 2007; Eddleton was most recently chief lending officer at Soarion Credit Union.
GeoVista Credit Union (Hinesville, GA; ~$247M assets) named Vanessa McGarry CEO to succeed Elaine Tuten, who is retiring after a 52-year career and stays on as president during the transition.

Ardent Credit Union (Philadelphia) announced President/CEO Rob Werner will retire at the end of Q1 2027; he stays until the board, which retained JSpire Recruiting, names a successor, expected early next year.
AllSouth FCU (Columbia, SC; about $1.5B assets) said President/CEO Bill Koehler retires Aug. 14 after 35 years in leadership roles; EVP Connie Hernandez Vizitei was named his successor.
Westmark Credit Union (Idaho Falls) named Derik Nielsen president and CEO, succeeding Mike Schenck who served 30+ years; Nielsen began July 27, 2026.
Silver State Schools CU (Las Vegas; $1.3B assets) appointed Ralph Ramirez president and CEO; he joined in 2023 and previously served as chief experience officer.
Holy Rosary Credit Union (Rochester, NH) named Kayla Selhorst president and CEO to succeed Brian Hughes after 22+ years; she joins Oct. 1 and works with Hughes through the end of 2026.
Achieva Credit Union (Dunedin, FL) appointed Nicole Tompkins as its first Chief Deposit Officer, a new executive role; she was most recently SVP and Chief Experience Officer at Mid-Hudson Valley FCU.
Credit Union of Denver selected Bobby Matthis as its new Chief Technology Officer, placed by search firm DDJ Myers; the CU cited his experience leading large-scale technology modernization efforts.

SCU Credit Union (Brockton, MA) promoted Kevin Brower to chief lending officer, merging its consumer and commercial lending departments into one team; he joined two years ago as chief commercial and consumer officer.
Campus Federal Credit Union (Baton Rouge) welcomed Ross Talbert as Chief Experience Officer, leading member experience strategy, branch operations and call center services.
UnitedOne Credit Union (Manitowoc, WI) appointed Angie Kenneke Chief Lending Officer, succeeding Amy Sonnemann, who recently became UnitedOne's CEO after the retirement of Kim Rooney.
Cornerstone Community Financial CU (Auburn Hills, MI; serves Michigan and Ohio) appointed Denise Miller Chief Financial Officer; she was most recently CFO of Monroe Community CU per the release.
CommonWealth Central Credit Union (San Jose) welcomed Janelle Huynh as Chief Financial Officer; she was VP, Finance at Provident Credit Union for 13 years.
Desert Financial Credit Union (Phoenix) named Kevin Martin its new executive vice president to help advance member experience and enterprise strategy.
Purdue Federal CU (West Lafayette, IN) hired Chris Sibila into a newly established role, Chief Strategy and Experience Officer, linking strategic vision to member and employee experience.

First Financial FCU ($1.4B; Sparks, MD per CU press materials) announced CEO Eric Church retires effective Oct. 5, 2026; President James Wheeler (appointed President in Oct 2025) becomes President and CEO.

rows.institution: Scott Credit Union (merging into Consumers Credit Union, IL)
rows.summary: Consumers Credit Union (Lake Forest, $4.6B) and Scott Credit Union (Edwardsville, ~$1.84B) announced a merger creating a $6.46B CU with 424,000+ members; legal merger expected June 1, 2027 pending regulatory approval and Scott member vote.

rows.institution: First U.S. Community Credit Union (merging with Sierra Central Credit Union, CA)
rows.summary: Sierra Central CU (Yuba City) and First U.S. Community CU plan to merge into a $2B+ credit union with ~113,000 members and 23 branches; expected completion 1H 2027 pending regulatory approval and First U.S. member vote; First U.S. President/CEO Shonna Shearson would lead the combined CU.

rows.institution: Sky Federal Credit Union (merging with On Tap Credit Union, MT/CO)
rows.summary: Sky Federal CU (Livingston, MT) and On Tap Credit Union (Golden, CO) announced plans to merge, creating a CU with about $671M in assets, 32,000+ members and eight locations across Montana and Colorado; no branch closures expected.

rows.institution: Greater Nevada Credit Union (merged into America First Federal Credit Union)
rows.summary: Greater Nevada Credit Union began operating as a division of America First Credit Union on Oct. 1, 2026, following the merger announced Aug. 24; the combination was approved by both boards, the NCUA and the Nevada Financial Institutions Division. Together they serve more than 1.6 million members through 135 locations across six states; America First, including this merger, has more than $27B in assets. All GNCU branches remain open and members continue using existing accounts, cards and banking services.

rows.institution: Launch Credit Union (merged into Suncoast Credit Union)
rows.summary: Launch CU members approved the merger with Suncoast Credit Union (Tampa) after a 45-day vote; the merger took effect Sept. 1, 2026, and the combined CU operates as Suncoast.

rows.institution: Piedmont Advantage Credit Union (merged into Truliant Federal Credit Union)
rows.summary: Piedmont Advantage CU members approved merging into Truliant FCU (both Winston-Salem area); the legal combination took effect Sept. 1, 2026 under the Truliant name and charter, creating a ~$6B CU with 355,000+ members and 40+ locations led by Truliant CEO Todd Hall.

rows.institution: Plains Federal Credit Union (merged into Caprock Federal Credit Union)
rows.summary: Caprock FCU completed its merger with Plains FCU per a Caprock news release; transition is expected to be complete by Dec. 1, 2026.

rows.institution: Vanderbilt Credit Union (merged into Fortera Federal Credit Union)
rows.summary: Fortera CU and Vanderbilt CU completed their merger effective Oct. 1, 2026; Vanderbilt keeps its brand as a division of Fortera, combined entity has $1B+ in assets and 88,000+ members, operational integration expected by end of 2027.

rows.institution: Advantage One Credit Union (merging with LOC Credit Union, MI)
rows.summary: Advantage One CU members approved merging into LOC Credit Union on a July 15 vote, creating a ~$750M CU with 47,000+ member accounts operating as Advantage One, HQ in Farmington; effective May 1, 2027 after regulatory approvals and systems integration.

rows.institution: ANCO Community Credit Union (merging with Streator Onized Credit Union, IL)
rows.summary: $10.2M ANCO Community CU (LaSalle, IL), described as significantly undercapitalized, and $423.3M Streator Onized CU are pursuing a merger giving ANCO members access to SOCU's broader products, branches and digital tools.

rows.institution: Lynn Firemen's Federal Credit Union (merging with First Responders Credit Union, MA)
rows.summary: First Responders Credit Union announced Lynn Firemen's FCU will join its organization; combined about 13,500 members and ~$470M in assets with two branches.
Aspen FCU (Rapid City, SD) launched Mahalo Banking's digital banking platform, implemented in tandem with its conversion to the Corelation KeyStone core system.

Synergent signed a seven-year renewal with Bayer Heritage FCU (headquartered in New Martinsville, WV; 45,056 members, more than $800M assets) for hosted Jack Henry Symitar core processing, plus five-year managed-solutions agreements (statements, check printing, digital deposit, bill pay, mobile deposit) and a three-year digital banking agreement. This is a renewal, not an open core buying window.

Synergent signed a seven-year renewal with Sebasticook Valley FCU (headquartered in Pittsfield, ME; 12,023 members, more than $186M assets) for hosted Jack Henry Symitar core processing, plus five-year agreements for debit card, statement, check processing, check printing and mobile deposit capture. This is a renewal, not an open core buying window.
